name: oracle-firefox
description: Capability-isolated ChatGPT Pro consultation, ZIP uploads, durable completion, and downloads through Firefox, native macOS Chrome, or Safari.
long_description:
One identity-locked per-user broker coordinates Codex, Claude Code, Claudex, and Claude Desktop through one safely selected browser backend. Firefox remains the compatibility default, native macOS Chrome is bundle-and-signature verified so Parallels or VM copies are rejected, and Safari uses a serialized visible WebDriver session with explicit session-only authentication. Capability-owned logical chains retain same-chat FIFO, durable completion, cooldown control, exact-turn correlation, and the one-send boundary across up to five qualified different-chat jobs.

The bundle never contains login cookies. Firefox and Chrome use separate dedicated local profiles; Safari uses an isolated automation session.
